title: Product distribution in zero coordinates
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set and let $\mathrm{law}$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$. The product distribution with zero coordinates is the point mass at the unique function from the empty index set to $\Omega$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{law}$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
